scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Clever Mouse Jerry, and today we're going on an amazing journey to discover the magic of confidence. Are you ready to join me? Confidence is like a superpower that helps us do things we didn't know we could do. It's like when you try a new game or learn to tie your shoes. So, let's put on our brave faces and jump into this adventure together!

Now, let's talk about what confidence really means. Confidence is when you believe in yourself, just like when you say, 'I can do it!' It's like when you pick up your toys all by yourself or when you share your favorite toy with a friend. Even if something seems a little tricky, confidence helps you try anyway. Remember, every time you try, you're getting better and better!

Let's explore how we can build our confidence. One way is by practicing new things. For example, if you want to learn how to ride a bike, you start with training wheels. Each time you practice, you feel a little more sure of yourself. It's also important to say kind words to yourself, like 'I am brave' or 'I can do this.' These words are like magic spells that make you feel stronger.

Great job listening so far! Now, let's try something fun. Can you think of something you did today that made you feel proud? Maybe it was helping set the table or drawing a colorful picture. Whatever it was, remember how good it felt. That feeling is your confidence growing. Keep up the good work and you'll see just how amazing you can be!

Remember when we talked about practicing new things? Let's think about how practice helps us. Imagine you're learning to play a new song on a piano. At first, it might sound a bit funny, but with each practice, the notes start to sound better. Confidence works the same way. The more you try, the more confident you become. It's like building a tower, block by block!

Now, let's learn how to handle when things don't go as planned. Sometimes, we might feel a little upset if we can't do something right away. But that's okay! Taking deep breaths can help us feel calm. Let's try it together. Breathe in slowly, and then breathe out. Doing this helps us feel ready to try again. Remember, every mistake is a step toward learning!

Wonderful! You're doing great by practicing calmness. Now, let's think about how we can cheer ourselves on. Just like a cheerleader at a game, we can say, 'Go, go, go!' to ourselves. It's like having a little cheer team inside you, always ready to support you. So whenever you feel unsure, remember your cheer team is right there with you!

Let's continue with a story about a time I felt brave. Once, I wanted to climb a big tree in the park. At first, I was a little scared because it was so tall. But then I thought of all the fun I could have if I tried. I took a deep breath and started climbing, one branch at a time. When I reached the top, I felt like a superhero! That’s what confidence can do!

Can you think of a time when you felt really confident? Maybe it was riding a bike or sharing a story with your friends. How did it make you feel? It's important to remember these moments because they remind us that we can be brave and try new things. Would you like to share your story with someone today?

Now that we've shared some stories, let's think about ways to help others feel confident too. When you see a friend trying something new, you can say, 'You can do it!' or 'I'm here to help.' This makes them feel happy and supported. Being a good friend means sharing your confidence with others, just like sharing a smile or a hug.

We've learned so much about confidence today! It's like a little seed inside us that grows every time we try something new. Whether it's learning to tie your shoes or helping a friend, each moment adds to our confidence. Remember, you are brave, and you can do anything you set your mind to. Let's keep building that confidence together!

Before we finish, let's do a quick exercise to boost our confidence. Stand up tall, like a superhero, with your hands on your hips. Take a deep breath and say, 'I am strong!' Feel the power in your voice and in your heart. This is your confidence pose, and you can use it whenever you need a little boost. Great job!

You're amazing for trying all these new things today! Remember, confidence is your special power that grows with you. Each day, you can discover new ways to be brave and try new things. Keep practicing, and soon you'll be doing things you never thought possible. You're a superstar, and you can shine bright!

As we wrap up our adventure on confidence, remember that you are never alone. I'm always here cheering you on, just like you can cheer for yourself. Confidence is your friend, helping you find joy in every new challenge. Keep exploring, keep trying, and keep being the wonderful you. You're doing a fantastic job!

Thank you for spending this time with me, brave adventurer! Remember, confidence is a journey, and every step you take is a step closer to your dreams. Keep being curious, keep being kind, and keep being confident. Until next time, keep shining and remember, you are amazing! Goodbye for now, my friend!
